purpose: Record the help command family dry-run extraction proof before any physical package split.
policy: The help family may only move after golden output tests, topic alias checks, docs-check wiring, and rollback evidence pass from the current single-package layout.

dryRunFindings.finding: printHelp still writes through package-level cliOutputln, so physical extraction should introduce a small output adapter instead of moving global IO helpers.
topLevelHelpAliases, nestedHelpAliases, canonicalHelpTopic, and trimHelpTopicPositionals stay in the help family and are covered by topic boundary tests.
NO_COLOR golden tests pin Usage, Available Commands, Flags, and Examples rendering for representative root, nested, and plugin topics.

physicalSplitAdmission.nextAllowedAction: Move the help family only in a dedicated commit after introducing an output adapter and preserving all golden output.
physicalSplitAdmission.rollbackRequirement: Restore all help_*.go files and help.go to cmd/gofly/internal/command in one commit if topic routing, help rendering, docs-check, or CLI surface gates regress.
